character.appendages: The silhouette has two attached swept-back top fins or ear-like crests, one pointed rear fin, and tiny underside contact nubs. These parts bend, flatten or tuck with the body. Do not add arms, long legs, paws, wings, horns, detached particles or a second tail.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas is 64x64 with source origin [32,45]. All 82 Main/Sub slots use that common origin. Low forms sit just above the origin, upright forms extend to y=-29, flattened forms preserve their authored lateral placement, and all canonical aliases retain their recorded translations.
character.faceAndExpression: The leading-side eye is clear in neutral and diagonal poses. Low or rear-facing poses compress or hide it. Upright effort and alarm poses open a tall dark mouth with a magenta lower interior; silhouette and stone states reduce the face to their donor-proven marks.
character.locomotion: The low body rocks and glides laterally, compresses flat, pivots diagonally, makes short lifted turns and rears into a narrow upright stretch. Preserve raw sequence IDs, exact timing and the common origin; do not assign or invent action names.
character.morphology: Tiny low-profile aquatic or seedling-like creature with one oval body mass, a pointed leading face, paired swept-back top fins, a single rear fin and minute underside contacts. The replacement must keep this low limbed-or-fin-contact motion topology so every compressed, lifted and upright donor pose remains readable.
character.restraint: Main cells 026-042 are the restrained block, including aliases. A gold external band crosses the body while the creature repeats low side, diagonal, upright open-mouth and flattened poses. The band follows body rotation and compression and must remain external equipment rather than anatomy.
character.specialStates: Main 043/045 are orange-red special-color states; 046 is the black upright silhouette; 047 is the black compact silhouette; 060 is stone-gray; and 063 is the white evolution silhouette. Palette-only or silhouette states may be derived deterministically only when alpha equivalence proves the contour. Main 061 and 062 remain distinct normal-palette motion cells.
